description: One 8-K Item 2.02 earnings release with its plain-text exhibit body. Free with no sign-in: AAPL, MSFT, JPM, KO, XOM, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TSLA, LLY. Costs 5 credits. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.
